contract: Normal main install-image -> install_control_image -> _install_locked -> _run: every Docker child gets anonymous private config, including discovery/base inspect/control and native builds/readback; no CLI interface expansion or new owner/harness.

implementation.location: Each _run creates its own .docker-client-* under validated cwd.parent: installed releases/ for bundle callers, omnis/ for native staged caller. Outside both build contexts and sealed bundle inventory; no persistent store or receipt schema change.
implementation.rationale: Docker CLI LoadDefaultConfigFile calls DetectDefaultStore only when ContainsAuth is false. ContainsAuth includes len(AuthConfigs)>0; empty anonymous registry entry prevents automatic helper discovery without invented credentials. No credsStore/credHelpers/proxies/currentContext/plugins fields. Explicit --config plus child HOME and DOCKER_CONFIG bind all clients/plugins to fresh private state; only PATH is inherited.
implementation.default_context_limit: Fresh isolated default local context only. Nondefault response refuses before inspect; missing/unsafe endpoint still refuses through unchanged _checked_socket. Personal/rootless/remote contexts are not copied/adopted. Existing receipt host/daemon comparison remains authoritative; existing live installations are untouched.
implementation.cleanup: 0700 TemporaryDirectory, exclusive 0600 config file; scope remains alive through synchronous subprocess.run. Cleanup owns only fresh directory on success, spawn exception, or timeout. Existing ImageInstallError normalization and interrupted-intent/no-retry uncertainty retained. No daemon settlement or descendant cleanup claim; no process-owner redesign. Abrupt process death can retain anonymous scratch state, never adopted on retry.
implementation.unchanged: Canonical Unix socket validation; daemon/image/provenance/intent/replay guards; ambient DOCKER_* refusal; 15s reads/300s builds; API/native/UI/artifacts and parent docs. No actual personal configuration read claimed.
